# Form struct fields parse float64 and float32 values with strconv.ParseFloat.
# Floats stay unsupported as path parameters by design; see call_test.go.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /sales AddSale(ctx, form)" -}}price={{.Result.Price}} ratio={{.Result.Ratio}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type SaleForm struct {
	Price float64 `name:"price"`
	Ratio float32 `name:"ratio"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) AddSale(_ context.Context, f SaleForm) (SaleForm, error) { return f, nil }
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func postForm(t *testing.T, form url.Values) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/sales", strings.NewReader(form.Encode()))
	req.Header.Set("content-type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	return rec
}

func TestFloatFormFields(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("floats parse", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := postForm(t, url.Values{"price": []string{"19.99"}, "ratio": []string{"0.5"}})
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "price=19.99") || !strings.Contains(body, "ratio=0.5") {
			t.Errorf("body %q does not contain the parsed float values", body)
		}
	})
	t.Run("a bad float responds 400", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := postForm(t, url.Values{"price": []string{"abc"}, "ratio": []string{"0.5"}})
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
	})
}
